scope: Oito configurações alternativas adultas com rosto vivo exposto; preservar versões de helmet fechado.

forms.name: Geordraco
forms.face: BULL-DRAGON head: broad long horn-rooted skull, squared deep muzzle, heavy ivory paper lower jaw, deep-set VIOLET eyes, two short upper fangs just revealed by a controlled warning snarl. EMERALD taut-paper forehead and cheeks with IVORY snout planes, TWO thick backward-curled gold/cream real horns. No beard or human lips. Thick short paper neck exposed between massive armor collar segments. Retain compact stocky two-armed two-legged knight, lance and tall dragonface shield. More bestial hunched-forward stance, four fingers+thumb gauntlets still functional, feet large two-toed dragon claws rather than human boots. Head is a creature, green metal upper crest above brow only; all lower face organic folded paper.

forms.name: Lacustrel
forms.face: RIVER-DRAGON head: long slender wedge snout and low swept cheek fins, small intense MINT-GREEN organic eyes set under deep cobalt brow, ivory/cyan paper jaw with two backward protruding lower-jaw tusk teeth (small, do not become sabers), tight closed snarl on one side. TWO flat blue swept real horns flow backward with turquoise kite ear fins. Not equine humanface, not birdbeak. Long elegant turquoise paper neck, quiet broad folds and cream throat keel. Preserve tall two-armed TWO-legged duelist and one ivory/cyan bamboo framed sword held by RIGHT hand on grip only, left hand open away from blade. Partial silver crown/temple guard leaves muzzle naked. Keep paired silver dragon-relief pauldrons, lilac coat and one blue-silver rabiola. Adult vigilant dignity, no toy expression.

forms.name: Valdrisa
forms.face: WYVERN-DRAGON living head, small relative to soaring body: very narrow long curved PLUM/cyan snout, ivory sharp cheek plates, deep BLUE irises and small black pupils, angular nasal ridge, visibly articulated jaw slightly open showing THREE predatory teeth, TWO thin backward swept natural dragon horns and two short cyan earfrills. No humanoid face, not bird with beak; a real upper/lower jaw of folded living paper. Partial silver browpiece on top only. Retain bold altered anatomy: TWO arms, TWO long reverse-jointed taloned legs, TWO enormous asymmetric ice-white/cyan bamboo kite wings, one long S anatomical tail, ONE soul-rabiola at tail-tip. NO additional braid across torso. One rescue halberd in right hand and other claw open. Dynamic low landing pose and diagonal silhouette. Show longer living-paper neck and elastic waist between silver dragonface armor plates; no nudity.

forms.name: Joanacendra
forms.face: CROWNED DRAKE living head with short but NOT cute triangular snout, blunt forward nose ridge, deep-set small TEAL eyes and dark graphite eyelid brow, strong white paper jaw, restrained TWO upper teeth peeking from closed-lipped snarling mouth. Pearl/smoky charcoal paper face and vivid MAGENTA cheek and throat insets, THREE blunt naturally growing ivory crown scutes on skull (not jeweled human crown), metal circlet rests behind brow only, entire mouth uncovered. Broad heavy neck split ivory collar folds lead into chest. Preserve stocky TWO-armed TWO-legged armored female commander with white/magenta tall bamboo flame-banner in right hand, left hand on chest, original metallic dragon-relief chest/knees. Natural torso is not a female human chest. Wide firm stance, adult serious organic pupils, no mannequin or smiling child. All banner finial complete with white top margin. One magenta braid rabiola.

forms.name: Cidraco
forms.face: TUSKED EARTH-DRAGON living head with heavy boar-like reptilian skull construction (still dragon, not pig face), wide squared snout with TWO lateral nostril slots, small deep EMERALD eyes, thick OXBLOOD paper brow and steel-gray/ivory broad lowerjaw; TWO short ivory upward lower tusks emerge beside a tightly clenched toothline, strong mature jaw hinge and TWO short backward curling natural gold horns. Partial gold/oxblood helmet back-cap and sideprotectors, ALL muzzle uncovered, no snout-shaped metal mask. Very thick short paper neck and massive hunched trapezius forms broad folds rather than muscle. Keep stout TWO-armed TWO-legged escort knight, saffron/oxblood armor, huge asymmetrical silver dragonface shoulder, one curved sabre and hexagonal buckler. Forearms thick and paws clawlike, feet broad. One heavy ochre braid with caravan flag. Weight and age, not cartoon grump or muscular human.

forms.name: Tomoeryu
forms.face: EASTERN RIVER-DRAGON living head: long laterally flattened angular coral/ivory snout with small JADE eyes under navy heavy brow, two narrow swept ivory cheek fins, strong pointed lowerjaw and THREE visible restrained fangs in slightly parted mouth. TWO smooth backward GOLD natural horns, TWO short dark paper moustache-like whisker ribbons rooted at cheeks (not human moustache or hair beard). Partial navy temple crown above ears, no closed visor or metal mouth. Long curved neck made of broad ivory/coral tension-paper planes. Preserve TWO arms TWO legs and both hands on ONE continuous naginata shaft, navy/coral full armor with sculpted silver dragon reliefs, broad fivepanel paper skirt and single navy forked rabiola. Lateral pivot stance with taloned dragon feet, mature calm predator face. No oversized round eye or slim human animegirl head.

forms.name: Bradamara
forms.face: CRUSHING-JAW DRAGON living head: squat skull small over huge muscular-looking but paper armored body, very broad square ivory snout with purple brow ridge, small VIOLET-PINK eyes deep in side sockets, powerful short lowerjaw and TWO thick flattened upper crushing fangs (not long saber fangs), mouth slightly ajar at one corner. TWO short thick backward ivory/gold natural horn stubs and layered mint paper cheek folds; open gold partial headband behind skull only, no face armor. Thick neck as few broad mint/ivory folded paper collar slabs no musclefibers. Preserve bold low TWO-armed TWO-legged draconic breaker with enormous gauntlet forearms, two-hand HUGE dragon-jaw marreta, TWO broad purple counterweight hip sails, long tapered anatomical tail ending ONE mint braided rabiola with lilac fan. Head alive and bestial rather than humanoid woman; full practical armor. Strong windswept low stance, coherent grips, no extra weapons.

forms.name: Rolandor
forms.face: ANCIENT SERPENT-DRAGON exposed head: elongated FOREST GREEN angular snake/dragon skull, long narrow ivory lower jaw, nostril pair near snout tip, small icy BLUE organic eyes under shelf-like dark brows, TWO swept horizontal horns as natural extensions of skull, THREE ivory backward swept cheek scutes. Jaw slightly open with two predatory curved canine teeth at FRONT, no human or wolf mouth, no metal jaw mask. Silver brow/temple headguard behind nosebridge only. Longer raised living-paper neck with 4 broad ivory throat overlapping folds. Preserve unique legless sentinel architecture: TWO huge armored arms, NO legs, ONE massive S-shaped paper dragon tail coiled on ground under high narrow torso, large silver dragon-face pauldrons and two immense forest-green kite gate capes. One hand on straight greatsword planted at side and other holding oliphant horn SEPARATED from mouth. ONE crimson braided soul-rabiola on end of anatomical tail, no second braid. Adult solemn primal authority, not cartoon cobra knight.
